note: Redis is now capped at 64 MB with noeviction, so once cache keys, throttle counters and job results filled it, every cache write failed and the health check reports cache error.

cause.title: fix: cap the memory of redis
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -42,7 +42,9 @@ services:
   redis:
     # Cache, rate limits and job queue; nothing here needs to survive a restart
     image: redis:8.10.3-alpine@sha256:21090af93f8324db2f0f0f4f38a7c60369d47d917e000c3423d89d2ae2883537
-    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no"]
+    # Bounded like the other services; noeviction: queued conversion and mail jobs are never dropped silently
+    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no", "--maxmemory", "64mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "noeviction"]
     healthcheck:
       test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
       interval: 10s
